definitions.explanation: Creating something new from one's own ideas, without imitating others. Most often seen in the forms {独創的|どくそうてき} (original, creative) and {独創性|どくそうせい} (originality).

examples.japanese: {独創|どくそう}に{富|と}む{作品|さくひん}。
その{研究|けんきゅう}は{独創|どくそう}に{欠|か}けている。
{芸術|げいじゅつ}の{世界|せかい}では、{技術|ぎじゅつ}よりも{独創|どくそう}が{評価|ひょうか}されることがある。
examples.english: In the art world, originality is sometimes valued more than technique.

notes:
Refers to inventing or creating something from one's own ideas rather than imitating. Most common in the derived forms {独創的|どくそうてき} (original, creative) and {独創性|どくそうせい} (originality).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独創|どくそう}に{富|と}む: to be full of originality
- {独創|どくそう}{性|せい}: originality
- {独創|どくそう}{的|てき}: original; creative

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {創造|そうぞう}: creation — the act of creating, broader than originality
- {独自|どくじ}: one's own; unique — emphasizes being distinct from others
